notes: Hex strings are uppercase, no separators, wire order. 'source' = 'legacy-test' (ported verbatim from the existing automated tests), 'derived' (computed by the specified algorithm; not in the legacy tests), or 'synthetic' (constructed for coverage; not a device capture).
Expected objects list ONLY fields that are present; every absent key means 'field not present in this notification' (null), never zero.

Parser rules: flags uint16 LE; any reserved flag bit 13-15 set -> reject; every flag-indicated field must fit; after the last field the offset must equal the payload length exactly (no trailing bytes) -> otherwise reject.
Pace fields are carried as the raw uint16 (legacy app labels them seconds per 500 m). See 08 §4.3 note on the SIG definition; no Omega Z capture has shown these flags.
